contract: Precise roots are enumerated by hard-coded walkers, not registered through an init-time address registry. The root families are identical in source and image boot; their storage provenance differed.

root_families.name: driver and recorded evaluator frames
root_families.lifetime: driver storage is permanent; nested frames are explicitly recorded

root_families.name: environment
members: globals mirror and fast buckets at env+0

root_families.name: private worker reserves
root_families.storage: fresh BSS registry of worker EvalCtx and atomically published top

root_families.name: exit tag and value
root_families.storage: current arena base +24 and +56; unconditionally traced even after the flag is cleared

root_families.name: shared symentry
root_families.storage: current arena base +872 points at a tagged symbol slot

root_families.name: macro and free-variable caches
root_families.storage: fresh BSS table pointers and current epoch; free-variable memo rows expire at collection; no cache registration is restored from the image

root_families.name: canonical symbol strings
root_families.storage: fresh external sidecar and BSS nil/t symbol slots

root_families.name: frame type symbols
root_families.storage: fresh BSS nl_frame_push_sym0 / nl_frame_push_sym1, repopulated at init; name bytes belong to the permanent intern region

init_difference: candidate4 allocated the driver's pool in a collectable image hole (nl_gc_is_boot=0), while source boot made it permanent. Disable free-list reuse throughout driver initialization, then restore reuse after freezing the watermark. This preserves all 36 initial allocations and their setup allocations, rather than patching one observed address.
independent_scratch_defect: The condition-case error/body scratch was an unrooted arena allocation. Its protected form could collect and reuse that address before nelisp_eval_call_with_err cleared its four words. A Valgrind remote watchpoint observed an actual 32 -> 0 block-header write at nelisp_eval_call_with_err+607; the destination was the scratch's last word. The malformed chain then made nl_gc_index_prepare return 0, so subsequent GC calls did not update live-byte accounting. The exit stash itself was already traced from the correct current arena base.
scratch_fix: Own a rootstack slot across the protected form, clause matching and handler evaluation, releasing it on normal completion, handled signals and propagated throws. Retain the fourth argument only for ABI compatibility.

regressions.census: BOOT_IMAGE_BIN=$BIN python3 tools/ai/boot-root-check.py --census-only compares 15 named slots plus reserve/frame/cache metadata using the same executable with and without its image companion. candidate4 fails on driver/pool; candidate6 passes in both modes.
regressions.retention: The full boot-root-check.py also runs the unchanged exit-stash check under three environment layouts in each boot mode. All eight cases pass on candidate6.
regressions.scratch: standalone-condition-case-root-check.el crashes on candidate5 and passes all 20 checks on candidate6. It forces precise-only collections in protected forms and handlers, checks retained payloads and heap structure, and detects leaked root reservations.
regressions.parity: The added shadow differential form returns (completed (error payload) thrown) on both GNU Emacs 31.1 and candidate6.

development_loop: The root census uses ELF symbols and the existing pointer API, requiring no new builtin or compiler bootstrap. Image-only census took 0.523 s in the isolated focused run, versus 90 s for the first debugger pass that targeted an unused inlined helper. The documented development REPL bootstrap failed with excessive-lisp-nesting 16000; the ordinary CLI probe remains usable.
